Method of Attack: Malvertising campaign distributing malware payloads camouflaged as document templates
Attack Vector: Search queries redirecting to malware-ridden template packs
Malicious binaries signed with stolen or unauthorized code-signing certificates
Indicators of Compromise: Code-signing certificates overlapping with Wauchos botnet, adware, and coin miners
Malicious payloads distributed between October 2018 and March 2019
